title: List the open titles
prompt: TaskItem and Sample are supplied. OpenTitles(List<TaskItem> tasks) should return the titles of the tasks that are not done, in their original order. The starter returns the title of every task.
hints: Which step decides whether a task is kept, and which step turns a task into a title?
Filter before you transform: Where comes before Select.
Add .Where(task => !task.Done) in front of the Select.
checkLabels: From the sample tasks, the result must be Ship, Label, Count in that order.
An empty list must give an empty list.
A list with only done tasks must give an empty list.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps the done tasks instead of the open ones.
Sorts the titles, which changes the original order.

feedback: Compare your result with the sample tasks one by one. Check which tasks are kept and that their order is unchanged.
